fullContentHtml:
IFCI Recruitment 2026 - Apply Online for 14 Associate Director and Senior Associate Posts - Complete Details

IFCI has released the new notification for the recruitment of Associate Director and Senior Associate New Vacancy 2026 for 14 Posts. The online application process will be conducted from 17 September 2026 to 27 September 2026. Eligible candidates can apply through the official website, ifciltd.com.

Important Dates

  • Last Date to Apply : 27 September 2026
  • Notification Date : 2 September 2026
  • Age Cut-off Date : 31 July 2026
  • Last Date to Apply Online : 27 September 2026
  • Interview Date : To be communicated to shortlisted candidates

Application Fee

  • Post Names : Associate Director and Senior Associate
  • Last Date to Apply : 27 September 2026
  • Post Name : Category
  • Associate Director - Estates, Services and Administration : UR
  • Senior Associate - Technical, Advanced Chemistry Cell : UR
  • Senior Associate - Estates, Services and Administration : UR
  • Senior Associate - Technical, Electronic Component Manufacturing Scheme : UR
  • Senior Associate - Technical, Infrastructure Projects : UR
  • Post Name : Qualification
  • Associate Director - Estates, Services and Administration : B.E. or B.Tech in Civil, Mechanical or Electrical Engineering. A relevant master's degree is preferred.
  • Senior Associate - Technical, Advanced Chemistry Cell : Bachelor's degree in Chemical, Electrical, Mechanical or Electronics Engineering; or master's degree in Science, Technology or Engineering in a related field.
  • Senior Associate - Estates, Services and Administration : B.E. or B.Tech in Civil, Mechanical, Electrical or another relevant discipline. A relevant master's degree is preferred.
  • Senior Associate - Technical, Electronic Component Manufacturing Scheme : B.E., B.Tech or equivalent in Electronics, Electronics and Communication, or Electronics and Instrumentation. MBA Finance or equivalent is preferred.
  • Senior Associate - Technical, Infrastructure Projects : B.E. or B.Tech in Civil, Mechanical, Electrical or Electronics Engineering, or equivalent qualification.
  • Post : Maximum Age
  • Associate Director - Estates, Services and Administration : 55 years
  • All Senior Associate Posts : 38 years
  • Last Date to Apply Online : 27 September 2026

How to Apply Online

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the online application / registration link.
  3. Register with your basic details like name, email, mobile number.
  4. Fill the application form with personal, educational and address details.
  5. Upload scanned photograph, signature and required documents.
  6. Pay the application fee online.
  7. Submit the form and take a printout for future reference.
